status: implementation and automated acceptance complete; integration follows
rootCause: Session_info was replaced between capturing its ID and loading its body on other connections. Startup configuration updates therefore caused a transient missing-row failure.
resolution: One bounded query-only WAL read snapshot per history response, including locators, mutable configuration, body references and bodies. No internal retry loop. Final authorization uses current data to reject deletion, restore or transcript rewrites.

actualIPC.scope: Actual Agent/CLI local IPC on isolated copies of the audited database. No model calls, no UI frame claims, original database untouched. CLI startup/IPC/JSON formatting are included in timings.

validation.deterministicRace: Captures native UUID page, replaces externalized configuration and collects old body, then completes the original page exactly once. Tests forward/backward, cold reopen, deletion fencing, read-only mode, independent writer/reader, lease return and shutdown.

runIdentityFix: Host create_run default and prompt fallback now generate full UUIDv4; Agent stores subsequent canonical run IDs as BLOB16. Existing opaque IDs remain exact; personal DB not rewritten.
